chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is pleased that his supplication be answered during hardship, let him increase his supplication during prosperity.

key_terms.الدعاء: Supplication, du'a — invoking God in prayer

ai.seo_question: How can I make sure my prayers are answered in times of hardship?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) counsels believers to cultivate a habit of frequent supplication during times of ease and well-being, so that God responds to their prayers in times of difficulty. This teaching reflects the Shia tradition that du'a is a living relationship with God, not merely an emergency recourse, and that consistency in worship during comfort builds the spiritual connection that sustains one through hardship.
